title: Statistics: Five-Number Summary, Box-and-Whisker Plots and Grouped Data
seo_title: Grade 10 Statistics Worksheets with Answers (CAPS Maths)
standard_text: Revise measures of central tendency in ungrouped data; measures of central tendency in grouped data (modal interval and interval containing the median); measures of dispersion: range, percentiles, quartiles, interquartile and semi-interquartile range; five-number summary and box-and-whisker diagram.
meta_desc: Free CAPS Grade 10 statistics worksheets: mean, median, mode, quartiles, five-number summary, box-and-whisker plots and grouped data. 100 questions with memos.
body_html:
How to think about it

  • Sort the data first. The median is the middle value.
  • Five-number summary: minimum, lower quartile Q₁, median, upper quartile Q₃, maximum.
  • Range = max − min. Interquartile range IQR = Q₃ − Q₁.
  • Grouped data: estimate the mean with the midpoint of each class.

Examples

Example

3; 5; 6; 8; 9; 11; 14

Q₁ = 5, median 8, Q₃ = 11

Answer: IQR = 6

Common mistakes

MistakeWhat to do instead
Not sortingOrder the data first.
IQR or rangeIQR = Q₃ − Q₁.
The classUse the midpoint.
